items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: he wanted us to play at the Moulin Rouge for him, you see? We opened the Moulin Rouge. So he told Joey, he said, I'd like to get your band to play for me at the Moulin Rouge.

ctx.x: That's Lucci. That's his name. Lucci too. They called Lucci, but his right name is Albert. So well, we all played together. So, and after that, well, so Speck wanted us to come back again. So we came back again. And what happened? I tell you what happened. No, he, Speck, what they did Speck during time of the war, see? The fella want to buy this place out, see? And you see, after Speck, after this guy done paid Speck his money back when he put it in the building, you see? He double-crossed it. You see? He sold it…
What's the name of that place? I don't know.
